When the user switches workspaces, what should happen to the active report filters?

A) Always reset the filters to the resolver's defaults on every workspace switch, with no new option.
B) Add a resolver-backed report-view setting, for example `resetFiltersOnWorkspaceChange`, with its default set to reset. Users who want filters to carry over can turn it off.
C) Remember filters separately for each workspace, and restore each workspace's last filters when the user switches back.
D) Other - name it.
